object.attr: analysis: a lightweight tag doesn't say who cut the issue or when, and `git push --follow-tags` skips the tag. Lightweight issue tags that exist still count as issues. Answered on 2026-11-11 (the author's question; the review and the analysis agree), to confirm.
object.description: When Mellon creates an issue tag, Mellon should create an annotated tag that records the tagger, the date and the issue.
